source: ISO 4026 M4 hex socket set screw, flat point: hex key s = 2.0 mm; tap drill 3.3 mm per ISO 261; stock lengths 4 to 20 mm. Used as an optional threaded traction pin: the threaded stud protrudes from the platform face.
frame: fastener: axis along Z, origin on the drive end face, thread toward -Z

tap_diameter.source: ISO 261 / DIN 336 tap drill for M4 coarse thread (6H), the pilot hole in a printed boss

min_engagement.source: ASSUMPTION: thread engagement in printed plastic of at least 1.5 x the thread diameter (uncertainty +/-2 mm); convention, not a standard

tool_access_height.source: ASSUMPTION: straight clearance above the drive end for a 2 mm hex key (uncertainty +/-5 mm)

length.source: request text (stud length; stock lengths are standard, so it is chosen per design)

gate_params.source: sample length used only by the load-time validation gate; never a design value

import_gate_notes: R1: bounding box = thread_diameter x thread_diameter x length, tolerance 0.2 mm (plain cylinder; the hex socket is omitted). Datum directions are unit vectors. Designed contact (thread in its tapped hole) is not interference. The tool_access keepout is a reserved volume, not a solid.

self_checks.name: hex key fits inside the thread diameter
engagement fits in the gate length

stock_lengths_source: migration delta R12: ISO 4026 M4 stock lengths 4 to 20 mm (the part's source text)
